name: software-engineering
description:
Write and change source code.

Invoke looks-good for a general review instead of composing review skills by hand. Looks-good stays off until you invoke it. Lean gate stays on until you turn it off in the project.

Path: implement → test/debug → simplify/review → looks-good. Specify and plan skills live in other plugins. Conditional skills load only when their trigger matches.

- looks-good: Invoke this for a general software review; it selects every applicable check on the current diff and returns one verdict.
- test-driven-development: Write a failing test for the missing behavior before you write production code.
- parameterized-testing: Put every case for one behavior in one table, and give each row a name. Conditional: many cases for one behavior.
- comment-police: Add no comments when writing or editing source, unless an exception applies.
- exhaustive-match: When you switch, match, or map a closed set of keys, handle every member or fail; do not hide a new key in a silent else. Conditional: a closed set is in the diff.
- systematic-debugging: Reproduce the bug before you edit. Conditional: a bug or failing test is in scope.
- verification-before-completion: Run the checks on this tree and paste the command and the output before you say the work is done.
- code-simplify: Delete and flatten extra code; use the language, then a framework already in the repo, then a library already in the repo.
- complexity-refactor: Measure cyclomatic complexity, then refactor the worst functions first. Conditional: large, nested, or highly branching functions.
- lean-gate: Before you commit or push, walk the staged or to-be-pushed diff and ship the smallest change that meets the request.
- requesting-code-review: Read the whole diff and write findings as file:line plus severity.
- receiving-code-review: Open the cited line, then fix it, reject it and say why, or ask if you need more. Conditional: review comments have arrived.
- change-architecture-diagram: Turn a pull request or a diff into a schema-valid document and first-party SVG blast-radius and data-flow diagrams without inventing architecture. Conditional: diagrams were requested.
